title: Roast cherry tomatoes and eggs on ricotta toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain kitchen staple: tomatoes, mushrooms, garlic, oil, balsamic, eggs, bread and ricotta.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a toaster and an oven, and cracking eggs into a tray is beginner technique.

works.reason: The quantities suit four, 200°C for 15 minutes then 8 to 10 minutes with the eggs is sound, and the ricotta toast soaks up the juices well.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes is enough to halve mushrooms, slice garlic and toast and spread bread, and the 15 plus 10 minutes in the steps matches the 25 minute cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the basil and optional chilli flakes, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast cherry tomatoes lead the dish and suit a July breakfast.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, friendly British English with no restaurant jargon or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Eggs, ricotta, vegetables and toast make a filling, balanced breakfast a family would want again.
